mapper.select: SELECT permission.code FROM iam_role_permission role_permission JOIN iam_permission permission ON permission.id = role_permission.permission_id WHERE role_permission.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND role_permission.role_id = #{roleId} AND role_permission.deleted_at IS NULL AND permission.deleted_at IS NULL AND permission.is_enabled = true AND ( #{tenantId} <= 0 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM iam_tenant_permission_entitlement entitlement WHERE entitlement.tenant_id = role_permission.tenant_id AND entitlement.permission_id = role_permission.permission_id AND entitlement.deleted_at IS NULL AND entitlement.is_enabled = true ) ) ORDER BY permission.code
mapper.update: UPDATE iam_role_permission SET deleted_by = #{operator}, delete_reason = 'role-permission-replaced', deleted_at = now(), updated_by = #{operator}, updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND role_id = #{roleId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_user_role ( tenant_id, user_id, role_id, created_by, updated_by ) SELECT user_tenant.tenant_id, user_tenant.user_id, #{roleId}, #{operator}, #{operator} FROM iam_user_tenant user_tenant JOIN iam_user iam_user ON iam_user.id = user_tenant.user_id AND iam_user.tenant_id = user_tenant.tenant_id AND iam_user.deleted_at IS NULL AND iam_user.is_enabled = true WHERE user_tenant.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_tenant.is_tenant_admin = true AND user_tenant.membership_status = 'ACTIVE' AND user_tenant.deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM iam_user_role existing WHERE existing.tenant_id = user_tenant.tenant_id AND existing.user_id = user_tenant.user_id AND existing.role_id = #{roleId} AND existing.deleted_at IS NULL )
mapper.update: UPDATE iam_role_permission role_permission SET deleted_by = #{operator}, delete_reason = 'tenant permission entitlement reduced', deleted_at = now(), updated_by = #{operator}, updated_at = now() WHERE role_permission.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND role_permission.deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM iam_tenant_permission_entitlement entitlement WHERE entitlement.tenant_id = role_permission.tenant_id AND entitlement.permission_id = role_permission.permission_id AND entitlement.deleted_at IS NULL AND entitlement.is_enabled = true )
mapper.select: SELECT user_role.user_id FROM iam_user_role user_role JOIN iam_user iam_user ON iam_user.id = user_role.user_id WHERE user_role.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_role.role_id = #{roleId} AND user_role.deleted_at IS NULL AND iam_user.deleted_at IS NULL AND iam_user.is_enabled = true ORDER BY user_role.user_id

SELECT user_role.role_id FROM iam_user_role user_role JOIN iam_role role ON role.id = user_role.role_id WHERE user_role.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_role.user_id = #{userId} AND user_role.deleted_at IS NULL AND role.deleted_at IS NULL AND role.is_enabled = true ORDER BY user_role.role_id

SELECT DISTINCT permission.code FROM iam_user_role user_role JOIN iam_role role ON role.id = user_role.role_id JOIN iam_role_permission role_permission ON role_permission.role_id = role.id AND role_permission.tenant_id = user_role.tenant_id JOIN iam_permission permission ON permission.id = role_permission.permission_id WHERE user_role.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_role.user_id = #{userId} AND user_role.deleted_at IS NULL AND role.deleted_at IS NULL AND role.is_enabled = true AND role_permission.deleted_at IS NULL AND permission.deleted_at IS NULL AND permission.is_enabled = true AND ( #{tenantId} <= 0 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM iam_tenant_permission_entitlement entitlement WHERE entitlement.tenant_id = role_permission.tenant_id AND entitlement.permission_id = role_permission.permission_id AND entitlement.deleted_at IS NULL AND entitlement.is_enabled = true ) ) ORDER BY permission.code
mapper.update: UPDATE iam_user_role SET deleted_by = #{operator}, delete_reason = 'user-role-replaced', deleted_at = now(), updated_by = #{operator}, updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
